lines.t: (Verse 1)
The dead awaken, the stars align,
The veil grows thin between the divine.
Every shadow bows, every storm grows still,
The promise comes — His holy will.
(Verse 1)
In the silence of the sky, I hear the thunder cry,
The trumpet calls across the sea,
“Prepare the way for Majesty.”
The nations tremble, hearts arise,
Truth unfolds before their eyes.
Every knee and every tongue,
Will bow before the Risen One.
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…),
Light of the world returning in glory.
The heavens open, the angels sing,
The dawn proclaims the Return of the King.
Grace and mercy, truth untold,
Clothed in light, His robe of gold.
Every soul will finally see,
The King of kings in majesty.
Voices rise like rivers of light,
Breaking through the endless night.
The Lion roars, the Spirit breathes,
The earth restored, creation freed.
“Holy, holy, holy — forever reign.”
“Holy, holy, holy — YahuShua’s name.”
(Verse 2)
The sky unfolds, the sun grows dim,
The song of ages sings for Him.
The Lamb once slain now stands forever alive,
The heart of Heaven has arrived.
The tears of saints, the cries of men,
All washed away — made pure again.
The Word fulfilled, the promise true,
All creation made brand new.
YahuShua (echo: YahuShua…),
Light of the world returning in glory.
The heavens open, the angels sing,
The dawn proclaims the Return of the King.
Grace and mercy, truth untold,
Clothed in light, His robe of gold.
Every soul will finally see,
The King of kings in majesty.
He rides the clouds, His kingdom is near,
The song of Heaven we now hear.
Peace and justice, love divine,
Forever reigning beyond time.
(Outro – ambient fade)
The winds grow calm, the stars still sing,
All creation bows before the King.
The trumpet blares, the echoes sound…
Behold — the Return of the King.
